excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content:
>  it could be a good idea to generate EIP numbers somewhat randomly
Most organizations number documents sequentially, and documents are referred to by number.  That's how we've mostly been doing it, and no need to change.  Letting the bot assign sequential numbers gets rid of the gaps in the sequence.   Drafts are documents that need numbers too, and an editor's approval being needed to merge that first Draft makes sham transactions difficult enough, I think.

excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content: I've heard nobody say they want to play favorites going forward.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: Lightclient has stated on multiple occasions that he thinks favoritism is appropriate and we should be treating long time/repeat contributors and core devs differently from drive-by EIP authors.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: This isn't a new position of theirs, and part of why we don't yet have a concrete rule on number sniping because we have never been able to reach full consensus on the topic.
